newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean blue chips rally to the close.
newsitem.headline: Chilean blue chips rally to the close.

text.p: Chilean shares ditched their morning blues and rose sharply in late trading on strong foreign buying and rumors in the electrical sector.
The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares closed up 1.6 percent to 113.20 points. The all-share IGPA ended 0.85 percent higher at 5295.28 points on heavy volume of 18.1 billion pesos.
"The force behind the market is coming from abroad," said one broker.
Most of the action was in the electrical sector, where renewed rumors that Enersis would sell part of its stake in Endesa drove up both companies and dragged along other power firms with them.
Endesa ended 3.4 percent higher at 259.50 pesos on the rumors and on a $650 million Yankee bond issue in New York. Enersis, which owns about 20 percent of Endesa, was up 1.6 percent to 257 pesos.
Rumors last year that Enersis would sell part of its stake in Endesa to a Spanish company animated the market for weeks, only to prove groundless.
Edelnor, a northern Chilean power generator owned by Southern Electric rose five percent to close at 190 pesos.
Chilgener, which Thursday opened bids for work on the Argentine segment of its plan to build a power transmission system over the Andes, rose four percent 2,351 pesos.

Investors seemed to be paying little heed to concerns about drought in central Chile on electric companies earnings' and were instead dazzled by the industry's array of new projects and ventures, said one broker.
"No one is talking about this drought anymore," he said. Endesa's gains were on massive volume of nearly 16 billion shares.
Other big gainers included Coke bottler Polar, up 3.9 percent to 345 pesos after Santander issued a buy recommendation, and foodmaker Iansa, up 0.7 percent to 96 pesos.
Brokers said they expected the bourse to continue gaining next week but probably at a slower pace as it consolidates the IPSA's 13-point gain since New Year's.
The day's handful of decliners included Oro Blanco, off three percent to 2.57 pesos, and Infodema, off 1.3 percent to 19.5 pesos.
